description: The pie chart displays the distribution of “6 Matches” across seven distinct categories, labeled numerically from 0 to 6, each representing a frequency tier. Following are “1” at 13.8% (4046 units, pale yellow), “0” at 13.3% (3910 units, off-white), “5” at 10.4% (3043 units, light sky blue), “3” at 6.8% (2002 units, olive green), and “4” at 6.2% (1810 units, muted teal). Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and absolute count, and the segments are arranged in descending order clockwise from the top. While the caption references approximate values (e.g., 30%, 20%, 5%) and a total of 9000, 6000, and 1500 units respectively, the actual data shown in the chart differs slightly, with the largest category at 27.2% (8006) and the smallest at 6.2% (1810). The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of the “6 Matches” category and the progressive decline in frequency across lower tiers, offering a quantitative view of matching frequency distribution for Persona 6.
